sections.text:
This document lists the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed 
on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The Cathodic Protection function is to protect the metallic parts from 
corrosion, this protection can be found in the following places: 
 -
Beside the Nile water pumps 
-
Beside the compensation tanks
 -
The 400 Volt room for gas units 
-
The fire fighting building

Procedure:
Introduction
This document lists the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed 
on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The Cathodic Protection function is to protect the metallic parts from 
corrosion, this protection can be found in the following places: 
 -
Beside the Nile water pumps 
-
Beside the compensation tanks
 -
The 400 Volt room for gas units 
-
The fire fighting building

Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Maintenance staff should be well trained and 
 qualified or directly supervised by any one who is.
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety 
 and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, 
 breathing mask, safety glasses 
 ... etc.
Tools and Equipments
Safety helmet, shoes, ... etc
Complete tool set, air blower
Complete tool set, air blower
Megger,
 multimeter
AC & DC
 Voltmeter, Clamp meter (AC ammeter)
Work to be Carried out
Rearrangement state: Connect all items which 
are disconnected.
The Transformer test :
Remove both tap bars on secondary
Read the AC I/P current on the AC ammeter
The current will be very high if there is a short in transformer
If the AC current is not greater than twice that shown in the test sheet than 
the transformer is OK 
The current is varying with the AC I/P voltage.
Remove both tap bars on secondary
Read the AC I/P current on the AC ammeter
The current will be very high if there is a short in transformer
If the AC current is not greater than twice that shown in the test sheet than 
the transformer is OK 
The current is varying with the AC I/P voltage.
The No-Load test :
Disconnect the O/P leads
The No Load voltage must be half of the normal voltage
Record the I/P voltage and current
Record the DC O/P voltage
Vary the I/P voltage and record the O/P voltage and 
current
Measure the bed resistance
Bed Resistance = DC output Volt / AC output Amp
